selectionEntries.comment: EXTRA UNIT COPY COSTS / GS37. Permanent required accounting entry. Troop and Other arithmetic remain logically separate but live directly on this single visible parent so New Recruit exports one surcharge line instead of repeating the aggregate through visible child ledgers. Normal-copy allowances are Practice 3 / 0, Quick 4 / 1, Standard 6 / 2, Long 8 / 3 for Troop / Other respectively. Custodian Guard is the sole native Troop copy family; eight native Other families use the Other thresholds. Each excess identical copy adds 20 Points. At Practice, every Other unit copy therefore adds 20 Points immediately. Left Hand of the Emperor remains a deferred Sisters of Silence integration placeholder, so no external Sisters units participate in local copy-cost arithmetic.

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## Adeptus Custodes 3.3.5

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

## Catalogue Bugfixes (September 21st)

• Presentation: Custodes now use the current emoji-enabled listbuilder template. Unit rows use ◆, model headers use 🦅, Loadout Options use 🧰, Leader Attachment uses 🔗, Unit Ability profiles use themed icons, and Infantry / Vehicle labels use the current Game System icons.
• Unit Abilities: the previous conditional ownership fixes remain intact; optional abilities still appear only when their actual upgrade is selected.

## Catalogue Bugfixes (September 19th)

• Practice games are supported at 420 Points, including Extra Unit Copy Cost rules and the existing all-Leader-Points cost for Shield-Captains.
• Selectable Unit Abilities now appear only when their matching option is selected: Arae-Shrike on all three Shield-Captains, Teleport Beacon when Custodian Guard select a Vexilla, and Smoke Launchers on the Venerable Land Raider.
• Unit Ability profiles remain available across all native Custodes datasheets.
• Shield-Captain Leader Point behavior and existing Custodes attachment rules are unchanged.
• Existing loadouts, Rare handling, vehicle options, and copy-cost behavior are unchanged.

## Catalogue Bugfixes (September 14th)

• Leader Points: Shield-Captain, Allarus Armour Shield-Captain, and Dawneagle Jetbike Shield-Captain now cost all your Leader Points; redundant Rare and pooled max-one listbuilder restrictions have been removed.
• Catalogue maintenance: current implementation notes and historical comments consolidated for the live GS21 catalogue.
• Venerable Land Raider: pintle weapon choices now appear directly beneath its main loadout choices with an empty default option.
• Arae-Shrike now uses checkbox-style Paid Wargear selections on all eligible Shield-Captains.
• Custodian Guard: Praesidium Shield now uses a checkbox-style Paid Wargear selection.
• Misericordia now uses checkbox-style Paid Wargear selections across all eligible units.
• Smoke Launchers now uses a checkbox-style Paid Wargear selection.

catalogue.comment:
CURRENT STATE
Adeptus Custodes 3.3.5 targets Game System revision 37 and uses the current Leader Points, Practice, Extra Unit Copy Costs, and presentation infrastructure. All 12 native datasheets are complete fixed one-model selections. Shield-Captain, Allarus Armour Shield-Captain, and Dawneagle Jetbike Shield-Captain cannot attach and each costs all Leader Points granted by Game Size: 1 LP at 420 Points, 2 LP at 800 Points, 3 LP at 1200 Points, and 4 LP at 1600 Points. Rare and the separate pooled Shield-Captain max-one listbuilder restriction remain intentionally omitted because the all-LP cost already enforces the same roster legality. Custodian Guard is the sole native Troop copy family. Left Hand of the Emperor remains an optional unchecked placeholder for a future reusable Sisters of Silence library and emits no unresolved external catalogue target.

AUTHORING & RUNTIME NOTES
All native datasheets expose their current list-building loadouts and paid wargear. Optional binary wargear uses direct checkbox-style selections. The Venerable Land Raider keeps its optional pintle choice as a zero-minimum radio selector directly beneath its two mandatory main weapon selectors, allowing New Recruit to show an empty option without an extra visible header. Extra Unit Copy Costs uses one visible accounting entry while preserving distinct Troop and Other arithmetic: Practice 3 / 0, Quick 4 / 1, Standard 6 / 2, and Long 8 / 3 normal-copy allowances for Troop / Other. Top-level Unit Ability names are represented as shared Profiles and linked to their units; sub-abilities are intentionally omitted. Custodes now use the current presentation template: unit rows use ◆, Loadout Options use 🧰, model headers use 🦅, listbuilder-relevant Leader Attachment rules use 🔗, Infantry / Vehicle category labels use the current Game System icons, and Unit Ability profiles use themed icons. Source-derived rule descriptions remain authoritative and are not edited for prose consistency.

HISTORICAL REVISION LOG
REV5: migrated Points references for New Recruit export compatibility.
REV6: added explicit model headers and polished Allarus Armour Shield-Captain package naming/order.
REV7: retrospective presentation/comment cleanup and current-state terminology.
REV8: adopted Troops/Other Additional Copy Costs at Game System revision 17.
REV9: retargeted to Game System revision 20, short-form Troop copy-cost rule, and Allarus loadout polish.
REV10: removed erroneous +10 Points costs from Pyrithite Spear & Melta options.
REV11: updated army-rules baseline to 3.3.4 and added standard Patch Notes.
REV12: updated army-rules baseline to 3.3.5 and Game System revision 21.
REV13: converted optional Smoke Launchers, Misericordia, Custodian Guard Praesidium Shield, and Arae-Shrike selections to checkbox-style presentation.
REV14: moved the Venerable Land Raider pintle selector directly beneath its main loadout choices and consolidated live GS21 documentation.
REV15: migrated to Game System revision 24 Leader Points. Shield-Captain, Allarus Armour Shield-Captain, and Dawneagle Jetbike Shield-Captain now cost all Leader Points granted by Game Size, represented directly as 2 / 3 / 4 LP at 800 / 1200 / 1600 Points. The legacy Counts Toward Leader Maximum tags, Rare category, non-attaching Leader semantics, and shared SHIELD-CAPTAIN max-1 restriction remain unchanged.
REV16: Leader Points cleanup after successful runtime validation. The three Shield-Captain roots retain their proven 2 / 3 / 4 LP all-points behavior. Removed their obsolete Counts Toward Leader Maximum links, Rare category links, hidden SHIELD-CAPTAIN Limit links and category, pooled max-one corrective errors, and the redundant player-facing Army List Restriction. Patch Notes presentation was updated to the September 14th cleanup convention. No points, loadouts, attachment rules, Additional Copy Costs, or other faction mechanics changed.
REV17: consolidated current-template update from the live REV16 baseline. Retargeted to Game System revision 37; added 420 Point Practice compatibility to all-LP Shield-Captains and Extra Unit Copy Costs; flattened the visible Troops/Other accounting children into one Extra Unit Copy Costs entry while preserving the existing arithmetic; adopted the current unit/loadout/model/category/attachment presentation; and added top-level Unit Ability profiles from the supplied Custodes ability map. The visible September 19th Catalogue Bugfixes section records only this actual delta.

REV17 EMOJI-FREE PRESENTATION CORRECTION: removed all remaining visible presentation glyphs from the Custodes catalogue, including unit-row chevrons and the local display text for Infantry, Vehicle, and Unit Abilities. Stable Game System target IDs, profile type IDs, mechanics, costs, constraints, modifiers, conditional Unit Ability ownership, and all other executable semantics are unchanged.

REV18 — CURRENT EMOJI PRESENTATION / DIAMOND UNIT MARKERS
Restored the established Custodes emoji presentation now that catalogue emoji use is permitted, while adopting the newer diamond unit-row convention used by the current Sororitas catalogue. All 12 native unit roots now use ◆ without commander medals; all 12 Loadout Options headers use 🧰; all 12 model headers use 🦅; the three Shield-Captain Leader Attachment rules use 🔗; Infantry and Vehicle category display caches use current Game System icons; and all 21 shared Unit Ability profiles and their links use themed icons. Custodes contains no Additional Model checkbox entries, so no Additional Model prefix cleanup was required. The five conditional Unit Ability ownership corrections from REV17 remain intact. No IDs, points, LP, constraints, modifiers, loadout legality, copy-cost arithmetic, or other executable mechanics changed.
